title: Marketplace listing sprint backlog and copy skeleton
content:
Purpose and scope:

This is a working sprint-backlog + copy skeleton for a cloud marketplace listing and partner commercialization entry. Aim: produce a launch-ready listing package (creative, copy, SKU mapping, technical manifest) and the minimum ops checklist required for publisher submission. This doc is intentionally lightweight — use as the single-source-of-truth for the next 3 two-week sprints.

High-level objectives (why):
- Get a validated marketplace listing (AWS/Azure/GCP) that supports Redwood Dedicated and Redwood Hosted plans.
- Ship merchant-friendly SKU mapping and short-form copy so sales and CS can reference the listing without bespoke collateral.
- Reduce time-to-listing by pre-baking assets, sample configurations, and a publisher-qa checklist.

Unresolved questions / assumptions:
- Pricing model: assume usage-based for Hosted + monthly commit for Dedicated. Confirm final SKU names with finance before final asset submission. (Action: Marco to confirm by 2025-10-09)
- Regulatory copy: Private deployment offering needs additional compliance language (SOC2/HIPAA) — legal review required.
- Logo/Badge: publisher has size + color requirements; design to provide variants.

Copy skeleton (short + long variants) — use these as first-pass content for publisher fields.
1) Short tagline (10–15 words):
   Redwood Inference — predictable, production-grade LLM inference with flexible deployment (hosted, dedicated, private).
2) 1-line summary (30–45 words):
   High-performance inference for LLMs with transparent latency and cost controls. Ship confidently with dedicated GPU pools, private deployments, and built-in observability for production workloads.
3) 150–300 word product description (for listing body):
   Redwood Inference provides a unified runtime to serve large language models with predictable latency and cost. Choose Hosted API for rapid integration, Dedicated capacity for committed throughput, or Private deployment for regulated workloads. Our platform optimizes batching, caching, and kernel selection to reduce per-token cost while meeting SLA targets. Built-in observability and rollout controls (canary, A/B) make it easy for platform and product teams to operate at scale.
4) Feature bullets (for listing highlights):
   - Hosted REST/SDK API for text generation, chat, embeddings
   - Dedicated GPU pools with SLA-backed latency/uptime
   - Private VPC and on-prem options with KMS/HSM integrations
   - Cost controls: batching, quantization profiles, cache hints
   - Observability: per-route tracing, token-level cost breakdowns

Marketplace creative brief (assets required):
- 3 logo variants (square, horizontal, mono) — SVG + PNG 1x/2x
- Hero banner: 1200x600 JPG (desktop) + 600x300 mobile
- 3 screenshots: Console model dashboard, rollout UI, latency/cost chart
- Feature icons (5) as SVG
- One short 60s explainer video (MP4) — optional for premium listing

Technical / listing requirements checklist (publisher common fields):
- Product name (final): Redwood Inference
- Short description + long description (copy above)
- Pricing model mapped to SKU table (see SKU mapping section)
- Billing contact and commercial SLA PDF (linked)
- Support contact and escalation matrix (email + phone)
- Terms and privacy URLs (legal page links)
- Regions supported and marketplace-specific availability
- Compliance badges and certs (SOC2/HIPAA/GDPR statement)
- Image and icon asset files + acceptable formats
- Test account/credentials for publisher QA (sandbox API key + sample payloads)

SKU mapping (draft):
- rwinference.hosted.payg — Hosted API (usage-based tokens)
- rwinference.dedicated.monthly-1 — Dedicated small (4 GPUs), monthly commit
- rwinference.dedicated.monthly-4 — Dedicated medium (16 GPUs), monthly commit
- rwinference.private.license — Private deployment (license + support)
Notes: this mapping will be canonical in billing system; do not change names after submission. Finance to confirm pricing tiers (Marco).

Acceptance criteria for listing QA:
- Publisher verifies assets and accepts hero/screenshot dimensions
- Test account returns expected responses for generation + embeddings endpoints
- Billing test shows correct SKU mapping in publisher sandbox
- Legal approves privacy/terms links and compliance language
- Support routing test (create ticket via marketplace) and verify escalation flows

Sprint backlog (by priority) — first three sprints (two-week sprints assumed)
Sprint 1 (Oct 6–Oct 19):
- Draft final copy (short + long) — owner: Aisha — DONE/IN_REVIEW
- Produce logo variants + hero banner — owner: Jenna (design) — IN_PROGRESS
- Draft SKU table and send to finance for pricing — owner: Marco — TODO
- Create sandbox API key + sample requests for publisher QA — owner: Ethan — TODO
- Compile compliance summary (SOC2/HIPAA status) — owner: Priya — TODO

Sprint 2 (Oct 20–Nov 2):
- Publisher QA pass (use sandbox) — owner: Ethan & Jenna — TODO
- Implement feedback on screenshots and upload final assets — owner: Jenna — TODO
- Legal review of listing copy (private offering language) — owner: Priya — TODO
- Prepare support runbook for marketplace tickets — owner: Aisha + CS — TODO

Sprint 3 (Nov 3–Nov 16):
- Final SKU pricing approval and marketplace SKU upload — owner: Marco — TODO
- Submit listing to publisher (AWS/Azure/GCP) and track ticket — owner: Aisha — TODO
- Run smoke tests on published listing in sandbox and production (if available) — owner: Ethan — TODO
- Post-launch checklist: monitor telemetry and early-customer outreach — owner: Jenna + CS — TODO

Launch risks and mitigations:
- Risk: Billing SKU mismatch causes incorrect charge estimates. Mitigation: run billing sandbox test and sign-off by finance pre-submission.
- Risk: Asset rejection due to size/format errors. Mitigation: pre-validate assets using publisher spec scripts.
- Risk: Legal flagged compliance copy. Mitigation: include conditional language and an addendum for Private deployments.

Notes to self / TODOs (quick list):
- Aisha: lock tagline and 1-line by Oct 9
- Marco: confirm SKU names + pricing by Oct 12
- Jenna: upload final hero + screenshots to shared drive 
- Priya: schedule legal review meeting with compliance team

References and links (working):
- Confluence: GP-2459 (master requirements)
- Jira: GTMP-1123 (marketplace listing epic)
- Slack: #marketplace-onboarding (publisher threads)

Change log (tracking in this doc):
- 2025-10-02: initial draft skeleton and sprint outline (Aisha)
- 2025-10-09: added SKU draft and initial design notes (Marco/Jenna)
- 2025-11-14: legal caveats section expanded (Priya)

End of doc.

-- informal notes: keep copy tight for merchant pages; avoid product jargon in hero; use measurable claims (SLA, latency) only if we can prove them in benchmark page.
